hook.name: RobinhoodEthUsdgV4LaunchHook
hook.description: Immutable Uniswap v4 launch factory for TOKEN/ETH and TOKEN/USDG markets on Robinhood Chain. Deploys token-only liquidity into permanently locked positions, then intercepts swaps via beforeSwap to internally match accumulated LP fee token inventory against organic buys at the current pool tick before those buys reach the AMM.
